data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement stems from a tool error in the qwen model - the LLM API request failed with HTTP 400 during the full PKGBUILD review. learnings: Tool errors (API failures) should be clearly distinguished from genuine inconclusive findings in the final verdict - a failed API call is not evidence of package risk
